failures: 20 complete independently reviewed held-out episodes required
50 independently labelled challenging non-advert segments required
95% of accepted intervals must have both boundaries within 1.5 seconds

metrics.note: Recall requires complete human review of entire episodes, including missed adverts. Candidate-only reviews do not establish recall. These are detector metrics, not production-safe skip accuracy.

note: Evaluation report only. No pilot renewal, rights grant, public rollout or population-wide safety claim.
